visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and a hair clip holds a pink cylindrical jar labeled 'Arencia' close to the camera. The background is a brightly lit bathroom with white wall tiles. (2) She opens the lid of the pink jar, revealing a pink, thick-textured paste inside. Graphic overlays of three different colored jars (blue, green, pink) appear in the top-left. (3) The camera focuses on the pink paste as she uses a small white spatula to scoop out a dollop. Large yellow and black text overlays appear on the screen. (4) The woman rubs the pink paste between her wet palms, generating a thick white lather. She wears a black t-shirt and a smartwatch. (5) She applies the white foam to her face, massaging it in circular motions. Red and white graphic text blocks appear. (6) She splashes water onto her face to rinse, bending over a basin. The camera angle is slightly from above. (7) She gently pats her face dry with a white disposable towel while looking directly into the camera lens. (8) She holds the small spatula with a piece of the pink paste again, demonstrating its texture once more. (9) The woman concludes by speaking to the camera, touching her cheek to show the cleaned skin texture. The lighting remains bright and even throughout.

(4) [Slogan]: 20種植物性原料. [Slogan]: 170小時熟成. (5) [Subtitle]: 是給乾性肌膚跟敏感肌膚使用的. 他強調呢是用. (6) [Subtitle]: 1000次的搓洗打光成型. 這我不是很清楚是什麼意思. (7) [Variety]: 無添加. [Subtitle]: 沒有添加SLS或是SLES. 並且他有放蘆薈 楊甘菊 綠茶. (8) [Variety]: 自然保養感受!. [Slogan]: 玫瑰果油. [Slogan]: 米糠 燕麥. [Slogan]: 甜杏仁 橄欖. (9) [Variety]: 素食O. [Subtitle]: 純素成分居多. (10) [Slogan]: #過敏原注意. [Subtitle]: 可能還是要注意一下. (11) [Subtitle]: 避免裡面積水 可能就會發霉了. 他的清潔力呢.
